memory_bridge: Let the arms-wide giant tour a campus: the entrance arch says 大学 for On ダイ, the giant carefully protects something 大切 for On タイ, and his sheer size is 大きい for Kun おおきい.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 大学（だいがく）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The arms-wide figure becomes a campus gate marked 大学（だいがく）; the first character sounds On ダイ in “university.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 大切（たいせつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Inside, the giant cradles one important object labeled 大切（たいせつ）; this word gives the other On sound タイ and means “important.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 大きい（おおきい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Zoom out until the spreading figure fills the frame and exclaim 大きい（おおきい）; the complete adjective fixes Kun おおきい, “big.”
